$comment: License gate for asset tools (plan 14 §6). Re-check a tool's terms before each batch of shipped assets and update checked.

meshy.use: Image-to-3D for ship hulls and props (plan 14 §5)

free.attribution: Required: credit Meshy in the project description

paid.license: Owned by the user (private ownership), if not published to the Meshy Community

meshy.verdict: Allowed for shipped assets on either plan. Free-plan outputs are CC BY 4.0, which matches the repo's asset license; credit Meshy in CREDITS.md and each asset's provenance record. Meshy deletes API outputs for non-Enterprise customers after three days, so commit the raw export to raw-assets/ straight away.
meshy.notes: Meshy's pricing page says the free-plan user 'owns' the output and also that it is CC BY 4.0; treat it as CC BY 4.0. The full Terms of Use license clause was not reachable on 2026-10-25, so read it once when signing up.

nano-banana.use: Gemini image generation: concept art, orthographic sheets as Meshy inputs, UI plates (plan 14 §5)
nano-banana.license: Google does not claim ownership of generated content; the user is responsible for its use
nano-banana.attribution: Not required by the terms; record it in provenance anyway
nano-banana.verdict: Allowed for shipped outputs (decided 2026-10-22). On unpaid tiers Google may use prompts and outputs to improve its products, so don't send anything private.
nano-banana.notes: The clause covers generated content in general; it says nothing specific to images.
